palette.notes: Code: 96 colours on the still (2 ramps, 48-long median ramp) because the sky and grass are smooth gradients plus white subtitle text. Teal sky, pale cyan clouds, green hill, brown hair, white shirt.

lighting: Soft overcast daylight; no hard shadows. Character is a dark back-lit shape against the brighter sky, which gives a lonely mood.
silhouette: Tiny chibi seen from behind, sitting on a hill: brown hair blob, white shirt, a dark arm or object to the side. Readable as a person only through context.

motion.timing: Code: 0.45 changes/s, median hold 2833 ms (p25 617, p75 3058); almost a still, with clouds drifting and subtitle swaps doing the change.

texture: Painterly pixel clouds with soft edges and light dither (code: dither share 0.0076); textured grass strokes on the hill.
camera: Static wide; the character is small and off-centre in the lower left, sky takes most of the frame.

acting.enters: Already there when the clip starts.
acting.acts: Just sits and looks at the sea while song lyrics play as subtitles; the stillness is the acting.
acting.depth: Character small in the foreground at the hill edge, sea and clouds far behind: lots of empty space around a tiny figure.

techniques: back-view character staring at a vista
near-still scene carried by music and lyric subtitles
small figure in large negative space for loneliness
slow cloud drift as the only ambient motion
big serif lyric captions centred over the sky
feel: tiny back-view figure + huge soft sky + near-zero motion + sad song lyrics = melancholy mood piece
for_fred: For a quiet or reflective beat, put Fred small in the corner, seen from behind, looking at something big, and hold for 2-3 s with only ambient motion. It is the 'small in the background' move Robert asked for; use it once as contrast to busy acts.
